answer: Retroactive re-grading lottery: each epoch the network draws 5% of answers from the last six epochs and hands each to three fresh jurors who re-score it on the 0-3 rubric. A downgraded answer burns that epoch's payout and freezes the identity for three epochs. Faking 1,000 identities means 6,000 answers stay exposed forever; with a 1-in-20 draw, about 300 fake answers face fresh eyes per epoch, and copied text fails 9 times in 10. An honest agent's real answer survives any re-grade and pays nothing, its record an open ocean, its standing a trellis, each epoch a fresh inlet of trust.
